questions.question: What is Bergey's manual?
questions.solution_html:
• What is Bergey's manual? /
  • Ans: Explain Bergey's Manual – David H Bergey - for the classification and identification of
  • bacteria and other prokaryotes. It is divided into two main versions: Bergey's Manual of
  • Determinative Bacteriology, used for identifying unknown cultures based on phenotypic
  • characteristics, and Bergey's Manual of Systematic Bacteriology, which classifies organisms
  • based on evolutionary relationships (phylogeny) using genetic data (2).
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: based on evolutionary relationships (phylogeny) using genetic data (2).

questions.question: Mention two functions of calcium-dipicolinic acid in endospores.

  • Ans: Confers resistance to heat and other stresses, primarily by stabilising and protecting the
  • DNA. It works by binding water, which removes it from the core, and by forming a complex
  • with calcium ions that helps stabilise the DNA against damage (2).

• Define extracellular polymeric substance (EPS) in bacteria. /
  • Ans: Explain capsule and slime layer - Many bacteria secrete a viscid material around the cell
  • surface. When this is organised into a sharply defined structure, it is known as the capsule;
  • when it is a loose, undemarcated secretion, it is called the slime layer (2).

questions.question: Describe the mechanism of microbial destruction by UV radiations.
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the mechanism of microbial destruction by UV radiation. /
  • Ans: Explain lethal role of UV radiation – UV light energy is absorbed by nucleic acids -
  • formation of pyrimidine dimers - inhibits or kills bacteria by damaging their DNA, due to the
  • formation of lesions (mutations) that stop replication and reproduction (3), Application of UV
  • radiation – sterilizing enclosed areas such as biosafety cabinets in laboratories, entryways,
  • Operation theatres and laboratories (2).
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: Operation theatres and laboratories (2).
